intro: Venezuela has Caribbean beaches, Andes mountains, vast plains and the tabletop mountains of the Guiana Highlands.

chapters.title: Tepuis and plains
text: Angel Falls, the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall at 979 m, plunges from Auyán-tepui. Flat-topped tepuis rise from the Gran Sabana. The Llanos plains are home to capybaras and anacondas, and the Orinoco River flows to a huge delta.
Over Lake Maracaibo, the Catatumbo lightning flashes on most nights of the year.

chapters.title: Climate
text: It is tropical, cooler in the Andes, with a rainy season from May to November.
